alt: 遊客站在寬闊石階前仰望高大的華美殿堂，層疊屋簷、雕花木柱與精緻窗格清楚可見。
scene_prompt: A magnificent, tall traditional public hall fills the landscape, viewed slightly from below so its generous scale is unmistakable. Several tiers of elegant sweeping tiled roofs, finely carved wooden pillars, graceful patterned lattice windows, handsome broad stone stairways and rich yet restrained architectural ornament. Small present-day visitors at the foot of the stairway look upward admiringly and establish scale. The building itself is the clear subject, no banners or inscribed plaques, no readable marks, no fantasy castle or generic scenery.
